g.text: INSIDE STATION 6: ASP.NET WEBFORMS & PLAYWRIGHT PORTAL BOT — EXPLODED ANATOMY & REVERSE-ENGINEERED DOM ENGINE
A. Persistent Citizen Profile & CDP Protocol
Prevents fatal "Profile already in use by another instance" crashes.
• Eliminates the top yellow unsupported command-line flag warning in Brave.
await dialog.accept(); // Prevents bot freeze on GoaOnline alert prompts
B. The Phase 1 Breakthrough: ASP.NET WebForms __doPostBack Bridge
1. The Problem: Synthetic CDP Mouse Clicks Silently Fail on ASP.NET Anchors
Target DOM Element (Proceed to Apply Button):
• Playwright sends low-level Input.dispatchMouseEvent to Chromium.
• Chromium does not evaluate synthetic clicks as trusted navigation
Result: Page remained frozen on overview with ZERO error thrown!
• ASP.NET WebForms does not use standard HTML form submission. It relies on a global JavaScript function `__doPostBack(eventTarget, eventArgument)` that dynamically populates hidden input values.
2. The Engineering Fix: Direct In-Page __doPostBack Injection
if (btn) btn.click(); // Triggers native browser event listener
✓ Confirms successful server-side state transition into REV05 Residence Certificate application.
C. 59-Control DOM Page Object Model & Cascading AJAX Address Engine
• Bot asserts Verhoeff validity BEFORE typing to prevent portal validation locks.
ASP.NET dynamically changes control IDs across sessions (e.g. `#id30` vs `input[name*="txtName"]`).
The Page Object Model uses a multi-tier resilient fallback hierarchy:
✓ Guarantees 100% locator resilience against portal ASP.NET re-compilations.
2. Cascading AJAX Address Modal Execution Loop
Waits for Bootstrap overlay backdrop to complete transition.
✓ Eliminates race condition where selecting Taluka before AJAX finishes clears the field!
Step 3: Detail Update & Two-Tier Confirmation Dialog
Bot pauses and leaves browser window live for operator to review all 59 fields before final submission.
D. Phase 3 Document Upload & Telemetry Suite
1. Document Slot Mapping & Strict Portal Constraints
Upload dispatch method: `await fileChooser.setFiles(resolvedPath)` bypassing synthetic OS dialogs.
• Direct headless file injection ensures the Windows native file picker window never interrupts automation.
2. Live DOM Survey & Human Simulation Tracker
• Recursively walks GoaOnline DOM tree extracting all input, select, textarea, button tags.
• Captures exact client IDs, name attributes, control types, and default options.
bun run portal:survey # Automatically discovers portal DOM changes
• Injects in-page visual floating HUD overlay into the citizen's browser session.
• Captures user clicks, keystrokes, dropdown changes, and ASP.NET postback timestamps.
bun run portal:track # Records operator actions into code blueprint
Enables 1:1 reproduction of tricky government portal workflows.
Why the Bot Stops Before Final Submit:
• Revenue Department certificates carry legal accountability under the Goa State Administration Act.
• Safe Review Mode leaves the browser headed window active so the human operator can double-check
all names, dates, address lines, and uploaded documents before clicking "Final Submit".
Loads `applicant_dossier.json`, fills Screen 1, coordinates Screen 2, and awaits final sign-off.
